items.text:
The obvious caveat here is this game is early access (at the time I write this) and there seems to be plenty yet to be implemented.

It's a space survival sim set in the nearish future, where humanity has colonised the solar system, but it's still a bit primitive, difficult and risky out there. You start with a small and rickety ship (and need to pay off the large mortgage on it), and you need to build up. 

At core, the gameplay is pretty solid. Mostly, you'll need to engineer your spacecraft, which is easiest to do by scavenging others. You can buy derelicts and fix them up, or strip them and sell the parts, plus a number of smaller quests (delivering stuff, investigating deaths). You'll need to manage your psychology as well as maintain your ship. There are appear to be some sort of wider stories or quests you can do, too, but these are primitive at this point. You'll also need to manage your character's psychology.

Controls are fiddly - learning how to automate commands is a must otherwise you'll spend a lot of time in frustrating micromanaging. This might be the biggest issue and hard for some players to get past: I doubt it will improve a lot come release (but the devs might prove me wrong). The AI could do with some work - your crew sometimes do crazy things like go on a spacewalk without putting their helmet on, NPCs sometimes get stuck in loops. Some optimising also would be beneficial. But like I said, it's early access.

On the whole, this looks promising and I've enjoyed what I've played so far.
items.text_zh:
这里显而易见的警告是，这款游戏目前（在我写这篇评测时）处于抢先体验阶段，而且似乎还有大量内容有待实现。

这是一款设定在近未来的太空生存模拟游戏，人类已经殖民了太阳系，但外面的世界仍然有些原始、艰难且充满风险。你一开始只有一艘小而破旧的飞船（还需要偿还它的一大笔抵押贷款），你需要逐步发展壮大。

从核心来看，玩法相当扎实。大多数时候，你需要改造你的飞船，而最容易的方法就是拆解别人的飞船。你可以购买废弃飞船并修好它们，或者拆解它们并卖掉零件，此外还有一些较小的任务（运送物资、调查死亡事件）。你不仅需要维护飞船，还需要管理自己的心理状态。似乎还有一些更宏大的故事或任务可以完成，但目前这些还很原始。你还需要管理角色的心理状态。

操作很繁琐——学会如何自动化指令是必须的，否则你会花大量时间在令人沮丧的微观管理上。这可能是最大的问题，有些玩家可能很难跨过这道坎：我怀疑到正式发售时也不会有太大改善（但开发者可能会证明我错了）。AI 还有待改进——你的船员有时会做出疯狂的事情，比如不戴头盔就去太空行走，NPC 有时会陷入循环。做一些优化也会很有益处。但就像我说的，这还处于抢先体验阶段。

总的来说，这款游戏看起来很有前途，到目前为止我玩得挺开心。
